source_summary: Local synthetic fixture evidence showing cache miss rates remained below 0.10 during healthy billing exports with durations under 400 seconds and batch lags under 30 minutes. This weakens the independent cache-defect hypothesis for this synthetic dataset but does not rule it out in real operations.
